title: Labor Warranty Terms Across the Ridgeline Installation Services Programs
content:
Installation labor on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract is warranted for a program-specific number of calendar months measured from the completion date. The program also fixes whether the warranty passes to a later owner of the home and how quickly a warranty service visit is booked after a workmanship claim.

| Program | Labor warranty (calendar months from the completion date) | Transfers to a later owner of the home | Warranty service visit booked within (calendar days after the claim) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 12 | no | 5 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 12 | no | 5 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 24 | yes | 7 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 24 | no | 7 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 24 | no | 7 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 120 | yes | 10 |

## Notes

- The roofing and siding labor warranty of 120 calendar months is ten years from the completion date.
- Only the window and door program and the roofing and siding program carry a transferable labor warranty; on the other four programs the warranty does not pass to a later owner of the home.

## Hypothetical end-date check

A Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation completed on 14 May of one year has a labor warranty running 24 calendar months, to 14 May two years later. A Ridgeline Carpet Installation completed on the same date runs 12 calendar months, to 14 May of the following year.
